# Yellowmetal (yellowmetal.store): full rates

> Yellowmetal Plants & Equipment Ltd (RC 9409523) hires, sells and lists heavy construction equipment across Nigeria from Festac Town, Lagos. 144 hire lines and 270 equipment prices, in naira, from the Buildocrat Nigeria Construction Rate Book (rates.buildocrat.store), as at 15 October 2026. Requests close on WhatsApp 0701 802 4292 (+2347018024292); email yellowmetalng@gmail.com.

Prices in naira. Base location Abuja; Lagos is about 5% higher for hire and 6% for purchase. Location factors: Abuja (FCT) x1, Lagos x1.05, Port Harcourt x1.08, Ibadan x0.95, Osogbo (Osun) x0.97, Kano x0.95, Kaduna x0.95, Enugu x0.98, Benin City x1, Uyo x1.03, Jos x0.97, Riverine / creek site x1.4. All-in hire = dry hire + diesel (litres/day x ₦1,870 per litre + 10% lubricants) + operator day rate. Exchange rate used for imports: ₦1333 per US$.
